name: Harmonograph
summary: One long damped figure, its two swings tuned to the interval between the two strongest notes.
credit: After the Victorian harmonograph (two pendulums drawing one damped figure). Written fresh for audioviz.
hint: Across and up swing at the ratio of the music's two strongest pitch classes (a fifth draws 3:2), gliding when the chord changes; the figure precesses with the music and the waveform shakes the line.

params.label: Damping
params.help: How fast the swing dies away towards the centre.

params.label: Detune
params.help: A second swing slightly off the first: the figure's slow rosette.

params.label: Speed
params.help: How fast the figure precesses, faster when loud.

params.label: Glide
params.help: How long a new interval takes to settle.

params.label: Opens in a build
params.help: How far a build lifts the damping, so the figure fills out toward the drop.

params.label: Sections
params.help: How far each section of the song moves the colours along the palette: a section that comes back gets its colours back.

params.label: Bar sway
params.help: How far the figure turns to and fro once a bar, as much as the beat is sure.

params.label: Waveform
params.help: How much the waveform shakes the line.
